amendment_reason: Pre-execution hostile review found that ordering candidates with the full SEMANTIC fingerprint leaks hidden coordinates into weaker SURFACE/TOPOLOGY/TYPED/CURRENT task presentations when hostile worlds intentionally share the selected view but differ semantically.

candidate_order.frozen_rule: ascending sha256(order_seed | selected model-visible view fingerprint | candidate_id)
candidate_order.why: candidate presentation may depend only on information available in the declared model view; hostile worlds that collide under that view must receive the same candidate order when their candidate sets are identical

MECHANIC_RANKING.input: context projection plus current-example candidate mechanic projections

oracle.name: EXACT_SEMANTIC_ORACLE
oracle.failure_history_rule: choose lowest-cost candidate not named by admitted matching failure history; if none failed choose lowest-cost candidate

additional_hostile_test: for every hostile pair whose selected view fingerprints collide and whose candidate sets match, candidate presentation order must also collide under the same order seed
claim_boundary: M0 validates task/evaluator plumbing only; no learned P9 capability claim is authorized
